# Set up the workspace

Work in the current local folder, Dev Container, WSL workspace, or Codespace. Do not hand the setup off to a remote coding agent.

Use the available task, terminal, test, and browser tools to complete this checklist:

- Install the dependencies declared by `package.json` and `README.md`.
- Confirm the lint, build, and test scripts work.
- Start the development server as a persistent task.
- Open the running site in the integrated browser when available.
- Give the learner a short, engaging tour of the workspace.

Respect the current approval level. Explain commands that require approval, request the narrowest approval needed, and never switch to Bypass Approvals.
